Statement.Comment: Write credential of the backup repo (pg nodes archive-push, backup-tools jobs): put new objects and read only the pgBackRest metadata it needs (backup.info, archive.info, manifests) - never backup data files; no delete (object lock 14 days, BACKUP_RECOVERY §3.1/§3.3). Expiry runs with the restore credential through the restore runbook (pgbackrest expire).
